parameters.name: AgentId
parameters.description: The ID of the agent, which is the same as the RAM sub-account ID of the agent.

parameters.name: EndDate
parameters.description: The end date in the yyyy-MM-dd format. The current date is included.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the call center.

parameters.name: StartDate
parameters.description: The start date in the yyyy-MM-dd format. The current date is included.
